title: Claude connectors: choose the app access your job needs
h1: claude connectors: connect the job you actually need
description: Get answers from the apps you already use. Compare Claude connectors with Metal connections, then pick one of 20 reading jobs to try.
answer:
**get the answer from the app instead of hunting through it yourself.** claude connectors retrieve data and act in services. anthropic's directory lists what each connection can read, change and access.[^1]

dusk connects through composio on its own screen.[^3] choose where you'll do the job: connecting gmail in claude won't connect it in dusk.

review.by: lead agent: independent reviewer pass against seo/facts (4 reviewers), every finding applied, automated gate

og_line: pick a task before you connect an app.

sections.h: what a claude connector gives you
sections.md:
**find the connection that does the job you keep putting off.** as of 12 november 2026, web connectors are available to all users. they work across claude, claude desktop, claude code and the api. free, pro, max and ultra include connectors.[^1][^2]

open the directory entry for its actual read and write abilities and availability. the plan gets you connectors; each entry tells you what you can do.

anthropic also supports custom connections for services using mcp. the [mcp guide](/guides/what-is-mcp) explains that standard.

sections.h: dusk has its own connection screen
sections.md:
**sign in once where you'll do the work.** in dusk, open **connected apps** and sign in on the app's own page. choose which bots may use it.[^3]

each bot can have the app off, read only, or read and write. you can allow exact actions too. dusk blocks changes from a read-only bot before they reach the app.

composio holds the connection; dusk stores no provider tokens. **disconnect** revokes the grant upstream.[^3]

sections.h: twenty reading jobs to try in dusk
sections.md:
**start where you already waste time looking things up.** these are dusk app tasks. anthropic's directory can expose different actions.

- **[gmail](/integrations/gmail):** find one sender's messages for a follow-up list.[^4]
- **google calendar:** find the meeting you need to prepare for.[^5]
- **google drive:** locate the named source file before summarising it.[^6]
- **google sheets:** read the cells behind your weekly status report.[^7]
- **[slack](/integrations/slack):** find the message behind a decision.[^8]
- **notion:** find the right project page or database.[^9]
- **[github](/integrations/github):** list your assigned issues before planning work.[^10]
- **linear:** read a team's issues before its planning discussion.[^11]
- **figma:** get file details for a design handoff.[^12]
- **stripe:** review invoices without taking payments.[^13]
- **hubspot:** pull up the contacts you need before an account review.[^14]
- **airtable:** read the table records you want to inspect.[^15]
- **asana:** gather tasks for a status note.[^16]
- **outlook:** list messages from your work inbox.[^17]
- **canva:** find the right design in your own collection.[^18]
- **salesforce:** find contacts before preparing account notes.[^19]
- **youtube:** list channel videos for a content inventory.[^20]
- **jira:** search a project's issues for a focused review.[^21]
- **excel:** list worksheets before choosing one to read.[^22]
- **discord:** review the servers your account belongs to.[^23]

**one useful answer beats a screen full of connections.** pick a question one app can answer. name the account and source material before adding another.

if the ai keeps forgetting your preferred format, look at [skills](/guides/claude-skills). app access gets it the data; instructions tell it what to do with it.

"read work gmail; return a list here" gives it a source and a destination. that's a job you can judge after one run.

sections.h: keep the first job read only
sections.md:
**a reading job earns its keep without changing your apps.** start with read-only access in dusk.[^3][^24] labels and page edits don't automatically ask first. for a job that needs writes, put "ask me before you change anything" in the routine.

connection failing? open the product's connection screen. confirm the signed-in account and the bot's allowed actions. more access won't fix a sign-in to the wrong account.

faq.q: why are my claude connectors not working?
faq.a: **start with the action you expected to use.** find it in the connection entry and read its availability.[^1] in dusk, use the separate **connected apps** screen and look at that bot's access.[^3]

faq.q: do claude connectors need a paid plan?
faq.a: **no: free includes connectors as of 12 november 2026.** so do pro, max and ultra. individual connections still have their own availability.[^1][^2]

faq.q: can i connect multiple gmail accounts in Metal?
faq.a: **yes, up to five usable accounts per app.** label them and name the account in each task.[^3]

steps: pick one reading job from the list
open connections in the product you will use
connect the right account with the smallest useful access
ask one question, then open the source behind the answer

items: you know whether the setup is for claude or dusk
the exact action exists in that connection
reading alone is enough, or the write has a review rule

mistakes.mistake: following claude setup steps inside dusk
mistakes.fix: use dusk's own connected-app flow. the two connections are separate.

mistakes.mistake: granting writes to solve a read error
mistakes.fix: confirm the signed-in account and allowed action first. extra access may not fix the failure.

mistakes.mistake: connecting everything before choosing a task
mistakes.fix: start with one app and one result you can verify.

tip.text: pick the question you wasted ten minutes looking up this morning.
